thread:
Hannah (Sec): Announcement: We're enforcing OIDC / ephemeral tokens for CI access to cloud resources. Static service-account keys and repo deploy tokens will be blocked starting 2026-04-15 00:00 UTC. Please migrate ASAP.

infra-bot: Org scan 2026-03-15 -> 37 pipelines using static SA keys. Report: https://go/internal/ci-ephemeral-scan

Kai (Platform): Migration options: GitHub Actions & GitLab -> OIDC; Buildkite -> OIDC or short-lived cert agent; on-prem -> instance identity + vault agent.

Renee (CI): Quick GH Actions example?

Hannah (Sec): Example snippet (GH Actions):
```
permissions: id-token: write
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Configure creds via OIDC
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ci-deploy
```

Omar (SRE): Buildkite wrapper image available: `redwood/oidc-agent:latest`. It exchanges pipeline identity for short-lived creds. Docs: https://go/internal/oidc-agent

Kai (Platform): We published a helper: `tools/migrate_ci_to_oidc.py --org <org>` which creates PRs with suggested workflow changes. It will not merge. Run in dry mode first.

Renee (CI): Enforcement behavior? Run failures?

Hannah (Sec): Pipelines that still use static creds will fail to authenticate and will log "access denied: static credential disabled". We will accept emergency exception requests for critical services (max 48h) via https://go/internal/sec-exceptions. Approvals: infra oncall + sec lead.

Omar (SRE): We'll run canaries this week on non-critical services and report failures here.

Hannah (Sec): Please prioritize control-plane repos and high-deploy services. Post blockers in #eng-platform or DM me. We'll publish a status snapshot 2026-04-12 16:00 UTC. :lock:
